title: The Liquid Fluoride Thorium Reactor:  What Fusion Wanted To Be
summary: A 2008 Google Tech Talk making the case for the liquid fluoride thorium reactor as an abundant, safe source of electrical power. It covers the technical motivations and design of thorium molten-salt reactors.
why: HN people link it as the original, technically solid presentation on thorium reactors whenever the topic comes up.

quote.text: Brilliant fairly technical presentation on Thorium.
